task.description: Documented example: retrieve county-level premature death measure for CHR&R release 2024. Returned data are filtered by measure, though full annual tables may be downloaded.
task.command:
library(countyhealthR)
county_data <- get_chrr_measure_data(geography = "county", measure = "premature death", release_year = 2024)
task.source_release: CHR&R 2024; tagged code maps year to Zenodo record 18331995; metadata tables accessed separately via record 18157793
task.source_family: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps relational annual release (Zenodo is hosting infrastructure)
